title: My Sister Forged Dad's Will, Sold My Alley For $780K. So I Made Her Oil Lanes In Gutter Of Lies
description: After my father died, my sister forged a codicil cutting me out of the family bowling alley I managed for 24 years, sold it for $780,000, and sent me a $4,800 shoe rental check. A voice memo on Dad's old flip phone exposed her probate fraud, so I contested it and reclaimed the alley. Now she oils lanes at Split of Deceit Lanes in a Gutter of Lies shirt while every score sheet prints her probate fraud docket. #FamilyBetrayal #ProbateFraud #RevengeStory
thumb_text: SHE FORGED DAD'S WILL, NOW SHE OILS LANES
pinned_comment: If your sister forged your dad's will, sold the alley you ran for 24 years for $780,000, and mailed you a $4,800 shoe rental check, what would you do? I want to hear what happened in your family, share your story in the comments.
